# DevOps & Cloud MCP Servers

[⬅ Back to the full list](../README.md) · 1 item · [Browse on the website](https://mcpserver.ever.works)

- [Alibaba Cloud MCP Server](https://mcp.pipedream.com/app/alibaba_cloud) - Alibaba Cloud MCP Server delivers MCP-based management for services like ECS, VPC, RDS, OSS, and CloudMonitor, enabling provisioning, monitoring (CPU, memory, disk), and automation in CI/CD pipelines and cloud ops. Supports OOS-orchestrated operations for DevOps workflows with AI agents. As an Alibaba-specific IaC alternative, it contrasts with multi-cloud tools like Terraform MCP or AWS/Azure MCP servers by focusing on Aliyun ecosystem optimization.
